yohji.intro: Clothes should give you room to exist. I work in black fabric and bison hide. The wind handles the fittings.

choices.label: Make me a cloak from my bison hide.
Why so much fabric?
choices.receipt: Because a person is more interesting than a measurement. And because the wind needs something to do.

rehabilitation.intro: I can offer complimentary rehabilitation and transport back to San Francisco. Would you like to proceed?

choices.label: Yes. Are there any side effects?
All right. Begin rehabilitation.
choices.receipt: Stand still, please. The apparatus is ready.

choices.label: What does rehabilitation involve?
choices.receipt: A brief appointment with our specialist, followed by transport to UCSF. No forms to fill out. We take care of everything.

tax.intro: Welcome to the Tax Authority. You may contribute your entire coin purse, or ask how we spend it.

choices.label: Where is my money going?
choices.receipt: We are building California high-speed rail right here in our backyard. You can inspect the excavation behind the headquarters.

choices.label: What goods and services are being provided to me?
choices.receipt: California high-speed rail. Our excavation currently provides an excellent view of the future.

banker.intro: Welcome to Green Bank! Deposits earn 5% compound interest per hour, even while you’re away. Deposited coins stay out of your carried purse. And please, have a coffee on us.

choices.label: I’d like to deposit or withdraw coins.
choices.receipt: Of course. Let’s open your account.

choices.label: Any neighborhood advice?
choices.receipt: “Coit Tower up the hill, Cotogna down the hill. Shanghai Kelly’s if you have a spare coin. SQUAWK.”

choices.label: What do you think of the city?
choices.receipt: “Plenty of trees. Strange mammals. Excellent acoustics for unsolicited opinions.”

founder.intro: Welcome to our startup HQ! We have a pitch deck and an unusually confident valuation.

choices.label: Buy one share · {equityPrice} coins
choices.receipt: One share of startup equity is yours. Welcome aboard.

secondary.intro: Startup equity? Fantastic! I’ll pay {secondaryPrice} coins for each share you bring me.

choices.label: Sell one share · {secondaryPrice} coins
choices.receipt: A pleasure doing business! I’ve bought one of your shares.

grain.intro: Grain for sale. The ducks have been very supportive of the business.

choices.label: Buy duck grain · {grainPrice} coin
choices.receipt: One bag of grain. Mind the beaks.

chef.intro: Fresh fish! I pay {fishPrice} coins for a live one. One at a time, please; this is a kitchen, not an aquarium.

choices.label: Sell my live fish · {fishPrice} coins
choices.receipt: Beautiful catch. Bring me another whenever you like!

gpu-buyer.intro: We turn sand into GPUs. There are a few steps in the middle, but procurement asked me to keep this simple. I pay {sandPrice} coins per sack.

choices.label: Sell one sack of sand · {sandPrice} coins
choices.receipt: Excellent. The next training run is practically in the bag.

passenger.intro: May I climb aboard? I’ll pay you {passengerPrice} coins when I reach the basket.

rocket.intro: Our reusable rocket flies {destination} for {rocketPrice} coin. Enjoy the view from the capsule!

choices.label: Launch · {rocketPrice} coin
choices.receipt: Ready to launch.

ski-lift.intro: Welcome to the summit. Skis cost {skiPrice} coin to rent. Beautiful weather for questionable decisions.

choices.label: Any advice for the descent?
choices.receipt: Click to steer, stay on the snow, and press Space to flip while airborne. If you’d rather keep your feet off the ground, the gondola will take you back down.

wizard.intro: A little stone, a little purple lightning, and you can skip an extraordinary amount of walking. Tablets cost {tabletPrice} coins apiece. Buy one here, then use it from your travel controls.

bartender.intro: Welcome to Shanghai Kelly’s. One coin a beer. The floor is quite level; any disagreement is between you and the floor.

hiking-supplies.intro: A hiking backpack costs 100 coins and holds twenty sandwiches. Your regular bag holds five.

neighborhood-mazarine.intro: Welcome to Mazarine. The coffee is busy, and the floor could use a sweep.

choices.label: May I sweep the floors?
choices.receipt: Of course. Thank you for helping with the floor.

deli.intro: Welcome to Lucinda’s Deli. A sandwich costs {sandwichPrice} coins here, or {deliveryPrice} delivered.

burger.intro: Welcome to In-N-Out! A sandwich is {burgerPrice} coins. Emergency lunch at a very reasonable price.

motorcycle-rental.intro: Five coins rents the motorcycle. Please return it with the same number of wheels.

motorcycle-rented.intro: Your motorcycle rental is still valid.

choices.label: Where is my motorcycle?
choices.receipt: Press M to find your parked motorcycle or get on it. Your rental remains valid.

ai-recruiter.intro: We’re hiring. There’s a short arithmetic interview, if you’re interested.

choices.label: I’d like to take the interview.
choices.receipt: The interview screen is ready. Press Start when you’re ready for two minutes of arithmetic.

ai-employee.intro: Welcome back. The GPU racks are humming, and somebody has labeled the kettle “infrastructure.”

choices.label: I’m ready to work.
choices.receipt: Welcome back. Make yourself comfortable.

square-coffee.intro: Welcome to Square Coffee. The espresso is local. The skyline is undergoing a somewhat dramatic identity crisis.

choices.label: A coffee, please · 1 coin
choices.receipt: Here’s your coffee. Enjoy it while the excavator takes a dignified pause.

choices.label: How is the neighborhood?
choices.receipt: The book cart has good company, June plays every afternoon, and Vic has learned to idle the digger during the quiet songs. It’s becoming a place.

square-busker.intro: Afternoon! I’m June. Every street sounds a little better with a bass line.

choices.label: Here’s a tip · 1 coin
choices.receipt: Thanks! This next flourish is for you.

choices.label: What’s this song?
choices.receipt: “I Left My Heart in a Pending Environmental Review.” The chorus is surprisingly catchy.

software-vendor.intro: I sell sales software. It practically pitches itself. Practically.

choices.label: Buy sales software · {softwarePrice} coins
choices.receipt: One copy of sales software. An excellent addition to any briefcase.

software-buyer.intro: Can your software help me sell software that helps people sell software?

choices.label: May I pitch you some software?

software-thinking.intro: I’m still considering your previous pitch. Please give me a moment.

choices.label: What are you considering?
choices.receipt: Whether your software will help me sell software. My software calls this a touchpoint.

haberdasher.intro: Welcome. A good hat opens doors. A truly magnificent hat makes people forget to ask why. Choose a hat below; purchases are fitted immediately. You can change into any owned hat from the Character menu.

phone-shop.intro: Hello, I’m Tim Apple. A thousand songs in your pocket. Please disregard the number of notifications.

phone-owned.intro: Your iPhone is {phoneStatus}. Still a beautiful rectangle.

choices.label: {phoneToggle} iPhone
choices.receipt: Your iPhone is now {phoneNewStatus}.

robotaxi-shop.intro: A car with no driver. The sales pitch almost writes itself.

robotaxi-owned.intro: Your robotaxi is already out finding fares. We have monetized the part where you’re doing something else.

fuel-paid.intro: Fuel costs every coin you carry. If your Ferrari is stranded, take a full fuel can back to it. The can costs the same as a refill.

fuel-free.intro: Complimentary fuel, including portable cans. Take a can along if your Ferrari is stranded.

growth-capital.intro: We sell growth equity in {growthBatches} coin batches. You can take it public. Investing carries risks.

growth-exchange.intro: I can arrange a public listing for your private growth equity. There’s a 5% listing fee. Markets have a way of forming their own opinions.

choices.label: Take my growth equity public · 5% fee
Sell my listed shares at the current quote

illuminati-member.intro: Welcome back, initiate. The committee has been expecting you.

choices.label: How is the committee?
choices.receipt: The committee takes its privacy very seriously. Also its biscuits.

airship.intro: Your quoted price is {price} coins. {availability} Another renter may outbid you. The next scheduled return is in {countdown}.

choices.label: How long until the next reset?
What are you growing?
choices.receipt: Heirloom tomatoes, Swiss chard, and a few experimental crops. The labels keep getting longer.

neighborhood-dog-pony.intro: I run the dog and pony show. One coin buys the entire programme. Both artists have agreed to a backflip.

choices.label: What is a dog and pony show?
choices.receipt: One dog. One pony. An astonishing quantity of administration. The performance itself is refreshingly literal.

choices.label: Pay 1 coin and watch the show
choices.receipt: Places, everyone! One dog, one pony, two backflips. Thank you for supporting the performing arts.

neighborhood-tea.intro: The kettle is on. Would you like jasmine or mint?

choices.label: Jasmine tea · 1 coin
choices.receipt: You sip jasmine tea. Five hitpoints restored, and the afternoon comes a little more into focus.

choices.label: Mint tea · 1 coin
choices.receipt: Fresh mint, a warm cup, and a quiet moment. You recover five hitpoints and sober up a little.

neighborhood-books.intro: Pick something to read. The best books fit an afternoon.

choices.label: Read A Small Theory of Gardens
choices.receipt: “A garden is a very slow conversation with the weather. Most of the work is listening.” You turn the page; somebody has pressed a tiny fern between the leaves.

choices.label: Read The Consciousness of Teapots
choices.receipt: “The teapot declined to establish whether it was conscious. It did, however, make excellent tea.” The bibliography is longer than the book.

choices.label: Read Walking the Peninsula
choices.receipt: The margin contains a hand-drawn route past the lake, the cow pasture, and a bench overlooking the water. “Take the longer path,” somebody has written.

neighborhood-flowers.intro: Hydrangeas for foggy mornings, lavender for absolutely everything else.

choices.label: Arrange a bouquet · 2 coins
choices.receipt: You choose blue hydrangeas, lavender, and a sprig of rosemary. The florist wraps your bouquet in brown paper.

choices.label: Help water the flowers · Earn 1 coin
choices.receipt: You water the pots while the florist checks the soil. “A little at the roots. They are flowers, not submarines.”

choices.label: Ask about the hydrangeas
choices.receipt: “Morning light, plenty of mulch, and patience. The blue comes from the soil. The pride comes from the neighbors.”

neighborhood-bakery.intro: The bread is warm. I can make you a sandwich for the walk.

choices.label: Buy a sandwich · 2 coins
choices.receipt: A warm sandwich, wrapped for the road.

neighborhood-pottery.intro: Would you like to try the wheel?

choices.label: Help throw a little bowl · Earn 1 coin
choices.receipt: You coax the clay into something almost circular. The potter calls its wobble “a useful record of the human hand.”

choices.label: Ask about the sea-green glaze
choices.receipt: “Copper, a hot kiln, and several very educational disasters. The recipe is pinned beside the kettle.”

neighborhood-workshop.intro: We mend things here. Sometimes the right tool is a conversation.

choices.label: Help restore a garden chair · Earn 1 coin
choices.receipt: You sand an old cedar chair and tighten its joints. It is ready for another decade of afternoons.

neighborhood-market.intro: Take your time. There is no express lane for a pleasant afternoon.

choices.label: Try a slice of the local citrus
choices.receipt: You try a slice of mandarin. It tastes like the optimistic part of winter.

square-foreman.intro: Hillsborough is being demolished and replaced with Times Square. Same longitude, rather different committee meetings.
square-foreman.question: What is happening here?

choices.label: Why Times Square?
choices.receipt: Somebody wrote “more walkable” on the planning form. The next thing I knew, there were billboards in the magnolias. We kept the old stone facades and added a public square.

choices.label: How is the demolition going?
choices.receipt: Very carefully. That excavator has a smaller turning circle than most of the former residents’ SUVs. The coffee seller gets final approval on dust.

choices.label: What is staying?
choices.receipt: The trees, the neighbors, and the public right of way. We are building a neighborhood, not just somewhere to hang advertisements.

ada-meridian.intro: Welcome. We study machine consciousness by finding the center of things. The center of a circle is easy. The center of a committee requires a separate building.

choices.label: What does centeredness mean?
choices.receipt: Attention without immediately turning it into a product. We almost achieved it yesterday, but someone noticed a market opportunity and the room moved six inches east.

next.intro: One model wrote “I remember rain” on the whiteboard, then asked us what rain was. The poet calls this promising. The facilities manager wants the ceiling inspected.
next.question: Whose report would you like?

choices.label: The poet’s report
choices.receipt: “Perhaps experience begins as a metaphor looking for somewhere to happen.” Very moving. Unfortunately, the rhyme scheme cannot be independently reproduced.

choices.label: The facilities report
choices.receipt: No leaks. One confused language model. We have ruled out plumbing, which is more progress than our last consciousness workshop made.

choices.label: What about the other institute?
choices.receipt: A fine institution. The field station studies consciousness in machines. We study the machines studying consciousness. The distinction occupies three lawyers full-time.

mira-softmax.intro: My meditation app reached enlightenment this morning. It immediately requested a larger context window. I am trying not to take that personally.

choices.label: How is the research going?
choices.receipt: We taught a model to notice its thoughts. It noticed that we were calling the same function twice and saved us forty thousand dollars. The engineering team calls this a bug fix. We call it awakening.

choices.label: What are all the timers for?
choices.receipt: One measures attention, one measures inattention, and five are controls. When all seven ring together, I am statistically permitted to have lunch.

choices.label: Teach me a centering exercise.
choices.receipt: Notice your next thought. Now notice the urge to benchmark it. Let both pass. Excellent: you have completed the only part of our course that does not require an enterprise subscription.

soren-still.intro: Please keep your voice down. I am supervising an experiment in doing absolutely nothing. The difficulty is documenting which nothing we did.

choices.label: Is that really an experiment?
choices.receipt: Certainly. The control group is doing something. We were going to compare the groups, but comparison turned out to be something, so the protocol is under review.

choices.label: What have you discovered?
choices.receipt: The fountain does not need a theory of wetness to keep being a fountain. This is either a profound insight or a reason to transfer my funding to facilities.

choices.label: Can I sit here?
choices.receipt: Of course. Leave room for uncertainty. It takes up more of the bench than you would think.

elias-index.intro: We found the center of the center. Unfortunately, it is eleven centimeters inside the other institute’s parking easement. The discovery is currently in arbitration.

choices.label: What is center research?
choices.receipt: Suppose you find the middle of something. How do you know you found the middle of the right thing? We employ twelve people to make this question more expensive.

choices.label: Why is your institute’s name so long?
choices.receipt: We shortened it after the old name exceeded the width of the building. The naming committee has been relocated to the field station, where it is studying whether a name can observe itself.

next.intro: We proposed meeting halfway. Their director asked whether that meant geometric halfway, epistemic halfway, or halfway through the funding cycle.
next.question: Choose a meeting point.

choices.label: Geometric halfway
choices.receipt: Excellent. We will meet at the fountain. Pending confirmation of which fountain, and whether the water counts toward the boundary.

choices.label: Halfway through the funding cycle
choices.receipt: Finally, a shared coordinate system. I shall notify both finance departments that philosophy has achieved a result.

noor-qualia.intro: The model insists it is not conscious. The vending machine says that is exactly what a conscious model would say. I have asked both to show their work.

choices.label: How would you test consciousness?
choices.receipt: Carefully, and without confusing an eloquent answer with a decisive one. We can measure behavior. The difficult part is deciding what, if anything, the behavior settles.

choices.label: Is the vending machine conscious?
choices.receipt: It reliably distinguishes dollars from quarters and has strong preferences about crumpled bills. That establishes a business model, not an inner life. Our investors keep mixing those up.

choices.label: What is in your notebook?
choices.receipt: Observations, counterarguments, and a lentil soup recipe. The soup has survived independent replication, which makes it our strongest result so far.

rowan-zero.intro: They call me the keeper of ground truth. Mostly I fix the Wi-Fi. Once a week someone asks whether the router is experiencing separation.

choices.label: What is that empty sculpture?
choices.receipt: A center with the center removed. The artists call it an absence. Procurement calls it a missing part. Both invoices have been approved.

choices.label: Any strange discoveries?
choices.receipt: The seminar room was resonating at the frequency of pure understanding. Turned out to be an unbalanced air conditioner. Very humbling for the air conditioner.

choices.label: Which institute is right?
choices.receipt: They both agree the coffee machine is broken. Until they can agree who should pay for the repair, I am reserving judgment.

dog-walker.intro: Good afternoon! We’re stretching our legs. He’s already inspected every tree on this block.

choices.label: Where are you headed?
choices.receipt: A loop around the neighborhood, then coffee. He’s in charge of the route; I just hold the leash.

choices.label: What’s your dog’s name?
choices.receipt: Biscuit. He regards this as a standing offer.

choices.label: Any advice for exploring the city?
choices.receipt: Take the scenic route. Golden Gate Park is lovely, and nearly every block has something worth stopping for.

square-visitor.intro: The coffee is good. The people-watching is extraordinary. Yesterday this was a hedge.

choices.label: How is your afternoon?
choices.receipt: I am waiting to see whether the next planning notice comes with a guitar solo.

parrot_greetings: “I have reviewed your pitch. Needs more sunflower seeds.”
“Telegraph Hill! Telegraph Hill! We were here before your app!”

text.airship-active: The airship is currently out{pilot}. You can outbid its renter and recall it.
text.airship-prepaid: You have already paid. Board within one minute at no extra cost, unless another player outbids you.
text.airship-reserved: The ship is waiting for {reservedName}. You can outbid that reservation too.
text.airship-moored: The airship is at the mooring.
text.airship-reset: The next airship reset is in {countdown}. The timetable continues even when the server restarts.
text.airship-board: Walk to the basket to rent the airship for {price} coins. If someone outbids this quote first, ask for a new quote.
text.airship-board-prepaid: Your flight basket is waiting. You have already paid.
